name: azure_devops_agent
description: Specialized agent for Azure DevOps pipeline automation - can trigger pipeline runs and check their status using browser automation

skills.name: Pipeline Execution
skills.description: Navigate to Azure DevOps pipeline pages and trigger pipeline runs by clicking the 'Run pipeline' button.

skills.name: Pipeline Status Monitoring
skills.description: Monitor and check the status of Azure DevOps pipeline runs, including success, failure, running, or cancelled states.

skills.name: Browser Automation
skills.description: Use browser automation to interact with Azure DevOps web interface, navigate pages, click buttons, and read status information.
